text:
Sam (Support): Customer (AcmeCorp) reports intermittent 503s for bulk /embeddings calls when they batch 64 inputs. Started ~2026-03-15 14:02 UTC. Happening across US regions. They see ~1-3% rate of 503s and client SDK enters a retry loop.
Nina (SRE): Can you paste a minimal repro payload and a short request log? Also want the exact model and region.
Sam (Support): Sent sample in DM. Model: rwd-embed-large-v2, region: us-west-2. Repro steps: 1) send batch of 64 short texts 2) observe 200 majority + sporadic 503s 3) SDK shows repeated immediate retries that amplify load.
Omar (Infra): CPU/queueing spike on our gateway during their windows? I pulled edge metrics for us-west-2 at the reported times — a 2x spike in pending requests for the embed route. No node OOMs.
Nina (SRE): Any 5xx traces? Correlation IDs from customer?
Sam (Support): One correlation id: cid=acme-20260315-9f4d. Raw gateway log: ``HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable\nupstream_status: 503\nerror: kvcache_lock_timeout``
Ryan (SDK): Their SDK version? Older clients might retry without jitter. That can cause retry stampede.
Sam (Support): They're on js-sdk@1.2.1, using default retry behavior.
Nina (SRE): Hypothesis: large bursted batching -> gateway kv-cache locks -> some requests time out causing 503 -> SDK retries immediately -> creates hot loop. Mitigation: reduce batch size & add jittered backoff.
Omar (Infra): I can add a short-term circuit on the embed route for 1 minute to shed retries from same tenant. Also will increase kvcache lock timeout slightly and add metrics to trace lock contention.
SupportBot: Incident ticket created: INC-2197, page policy: P2.
Sam (Support): I'll ask customer to try these two quick mitigations: 1) reduce batch size 64 -> 16 2) upgrade SDK to 1.3.0 which includes exponential jitter patch. Want to confirm repro steps and ETA.
Sam (Support): Customer ran reduced batch size test — result: 0/1000 503s in 10 minutes. With batch=64 they saw 12/1000 503s.
Ryan (SDK): Good, that strongly points to client-side retry amplification. Note: 1.3.0 also has default maxRetries=4 and baseDelay=150ms. Please capture timeline.
Nina (SRE): I'll deploy a rolling config change to increase kv-cache lock window by 50ms to reduce false timeouts; also pushing a hotfix to gatekeeper to throttle immediate retry bursts per-tenant. Rolling now to canaries.
Omar (Infra): Throttle rule applied to canaries for tenant-acme, monitoring.
SupportBot: Canaries for infra change passed for 5 minutes (no errors).
Nina (SRE): Change rolled to 30% of traffic. Early metrics show embed 503 rate down 70% overall for affected window.
Sam (Support): Customer confirmed traffic normalized after reducing batch and upgrading SDK. They've accepted recommended mitigations.
Ryan (SDK): Action items: 1) backport jitter fixes to older patch release? we should publish a security/compat release note. 2) add SDK docs recommending max batch size per model.
Nina (SRE): Platform actions: 1) permanently increase kvcache lock default for embed route, 2) add tenant-level rapid-retry throttling, 3) instrument per-tenant lock wait histograms.
Sam (Support): Communicated to customer: temporary mitigations worked, we will follow up with permanent fixes and an SLA credit review if they want.
Omar (Infra): Opening infra RFC for long tail: better queue-smoothing and circuit-breakers for batched endpoints. RFC-478 opened.
Sam (Support): I'll close this support thread after we push the config change globally and send final write-up. Marking as "investigating -> mitigated" for now. :white_check_mark:
SupportBot: Thread INC-2197 updated: status=mitigated, owner=Nina (SRE).
